threads.subject: UT Austin Student & PGN Member Interested in Banking @ Goldman Sachs

messages.subject: UT Austin Student & PGN Member Interested in Banking @ Goldman Sachs
messages.body:
Hello Barbara,

I hope you are doing well. I am a Fall PC ‘22 PGN member studying Business and Economics, and am pursuing a career in Investment Banking. I'd love to talk to you to learn more about your experience at Goldman Sachs in Dallas, and specifically your transfer from your Summer Analyst Internship at Wells Fargo to your current position.

If you have any free time in the next week, I would like to set up a quick phone call with you. I am pretty open and can likely adjust my schedule to accommodate whatever works best for you. Please let me know if you would be willing to do this. Attached is my resume.

Best,
Jonathan
